facts.fact: Kevin 在图书馆被毛线帽高个逼问——又是 Andrews。
时间线：凌晨三点半——Alex 一离开现场，Andrews 就逐个击破。
Kevin 逃亡路线：借口上厕所→锁电脑→偷 pool car 与 master 钥匙→侧门溜走。
facts.anchor: Took a set for a pool car, and a master set for some buildings in town

facts.fact: Alex 打给 Doyle 但坚持：这是 Lacey 的郡、她的副手——必须她自己动手。
facts.anchor: This is her county. These are her deputies. She’s the one who needs to make this happen.

facts.fact: 农民诉讼：两人确认死亡——一个「意外」死于农机、一个谷仓上吊——都在开庭前。
facts.anchor: One accidentally fell under his own farm equipment. The second hanged himself in his barn.

facts.fact: 第三人 Garrett Henderson 失踪：无信用活动无手机活动、妻子没报失踪——Alex 判断活着在逃。
facts.anchor: He’s just… gone. Dropped off the face of the earth.

facts.fact: 拒绝打电话（会惊动他）——要地址亲自查。
facts.anchor: Give me the addresses of the family. I’ll check them out myself.

facts.fact: 出城决定：明智？不。必要？是。
Alex 暗想：以眼还眼——兄弟、父、子，想复仇的人。
facts.anchor: Brothers, fathers, sons… People who’d want to seek vengeance.
